```typescript
import { ObserverSubject, DualObserverSubject } from 'bessa_patterns.ts';

// ObserverSubject: callback-based observer
const subject = new ObserverSubject<string>();
const unsubscribe = subject.subscribe(value => console.log('Observed:', value));

const dual = new DualObserverSubject();
